description: AeroAgent approval window: it only reads its request and answers it through the app's own ai_approval_prompt / ai_approval_decide commands, and drags its custom titlebar. Linux release builds load it from the local server on 14321 (see app_page_url), a remote origin for the ACL, hence the remote URL; the bundled page of the other builds stays covered (local defaults to true). Deliberately none of the default capability (no fs, shell, dialog or event permissions): the window that grants approvals holds the least of any.
